records.agenda_item: Consideration of Late Registration application for odd semester
records.discussion: The committee reviewed an application submitted by a full-time M.Tech. student seeking permission for late registration due to medical exigencies and delayed transit. The DMPC verified that as per Clause 4.1, no registration shall be allowed after the notified last date of registration except in special cases with the permission of the Dean (Academic) / Chairperson, Senate.
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the late registration request of the student to the Dean (Academic) for special approval, subject to submission of Form MP-02.

The DMPC verified Clause 4.1 regarding late registration restrictions. Resolved to recommend the late registration request of the student to the Dean (Academic) for special approval, subject to submission of Form MP-02.

records.agenda_item: Allocation of Thesis Supervisor and Academic Advising
records.discussion: The committee discussed the assignment of thesis supervisors and course selection for newly admitted M.Tech. students. The DMPC noted that under Clause 4.2, a student registering for thesis credits must have a thesis supervisor assigned to him/her, and students shall be advised in the selection of courses by the DMPC.
records.resolution: Resolved that the list of faculty supervisors assigned to first-year M.Tech. students for their thesis credits and course selection is approved as proposed.

Resolved that the list of faculty supervisors assigned to first-year M.Tech. students for their thesis credits and course selection is approved as proposed.

records.discussion: The DMPC evaluated an application from an M.Tech. student requesting a semester leave for the current semester due to severe unforeseen family circumstances. The committee verified that as per Clause 5.2, semester leave up to a maximum of two semesters may be sanctioned for valid reasons in the entire duration of the programme on the recommendation of DMPC and SMPC and approval of Dean (Academic).
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the semester leave application for one semester to the SMPC and the Dean (Academic) for final approval.

Resolved to recommend the semester leave application for one semester to the SMPC and the Dean (Academic) for final approval.

records.department: Department of Electronics and Communication Engineering
records.agenda_item: Review of Attendance Shortage and Examination Eligibility
records.discussion: The committee examined the attendance records of students for the ongoing semester. It was noted that students with less than 75% attendance in a subject shall not be allowed to appear in the End Semester Examination of that subject as mandated by Clause 7.1, which includes absence due to sports, medical leaves, and other types of leaves.
records.resolution: Resolved that warning notices be issued to students whose attendance is falling close to the threshold, and ineligible candidates be barred from the End Semester Examinations in accordance with Clause 7.1.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2023/03-05, Date: 2023-03-15, Agenda Item: Review of Attendance Shortage and Examination Eligibility. The committee examined attendance records pursuant to Clause 7.1. Resolved that warning notices be issued and ineligible candidates be barred from the End Semester Examinations in accordance with Clause 7.1.

records.agenda_item: Verification of Full-Time Non-Stipendiary and Sponsored Admissions
records.discussion: The DMPC verified the admission categories of newly admitted M.Tech. students for the academic session. The committee checked records for full-time non-stipendiary students under Clause 3.4.1.2 and full-time sponsored candidates under Clause 3.4.1.3 to ensure all employer sponsorship certificates and conditions are met.
records.resolution: Resolved that the verified list of full-time non-stipendiary and sponsored students is accepted and forwarded to the academic section.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2023/07-02, Date: 2023-07-20, Agenda Item: Verification of Full-Time Non-Stipendiary and Sponsored Admissions. The DMPC verified admission categories under Clause 3.4.1.2 and Clause 3.4.1.3. Resolved that the verified list of full-time non-stipendiary and sponsored students is accepted and forwarded to the academic section.

records.discussion: The committee reviewed applications for part-time M.Tech. admission. The DMPC noted that as per Clause 3.5.2, admission shall be done by DMSC/DMPC on the basis of screening considering candidate's experience, employment record, and employee recommendation followed by interview.
records.resolution: Resolved that the screened candidates meeting the requirements of Clause 3.5.2 are recommended for provisional part-time admission.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2023/09-01, Date: 2023-09-11, Agenda Item: Review of Part-Time Student Admissions. The committee reviewed part-time admissions pursuant to Clause 3.5.2. Resolved that the screened candidates meeting the requirements of Clause 3.5.2 are recommended for provisional part-time admission.

records.department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
records.agenda_item: Withholding of Grade Reports due to Dues / Indiscipline
records.discussion: The committee discussed cases of pending institute dues and disciplinary actions against certain students. It was reiterated that in accordance with Clause 8.3.7, the grade report of a student shall be withheld if he/she has not paid his/her dues, or if there is a case of indiscipline pending against him/her.
records.resolution: Resolved to notify the academic office to withhold the grade reports of the defaulting students until clearance of dues and resolution of pending disciplinary matters as per Clause 8.3.7.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2023/11-06, Date: 2023-11-28, Agenda Item: Withholding of Grade Reports due to Dues / Indiscipline. The committee discussed grade withholding under Clause 8.3.7. Resolved to notify the academic office to withhold the grade reports of the defaulting students until clearance of dues and resolution of pending disciplinary matters.

records.agenda_item: Consideration of Programme Extension for M.Tech. Students
records.discussion: The DMPC evaluated requests from senior M.Tech. students exceeding their normal duration and seeking extension of their programme. The committee verified the maximum duration limits and extension rules stipulated under Clause 7.2.
records.resolution: Resolved to recommend the programme extension requests for eligible students to the competent authority, contingent upon satisfactory research progress.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2024/02-04, Date: 2024-02-14, Agenda Item: Consideration of Programme Extension for M.Tech. Students. The DMPC evaluated extension requests pursuant to Clause 7.2. Resolved to recommend the programme extension requests for eligible students to the competent authority, contingent upon satisfactory research progress.

records.agenda_item: Post-Defense Thesis Resubmission and Examination Board Procedures
records.discussion: The committee reviewed the case of a thesis resubmission recommended for modifications by the Examination Board. The DMPC noted that as per Clause 13.1, for resubmitted thesis incorporating suggestions, the oral examination shall be conducted by the same Examination Board unless members are unavailable, and rejected resubmissions must be reported to the Dean (Academic) through DMPC.
records.resolution: Resolved that the same Examination Board be re-convened for the oral examination of the resubmitted thesis pursuant to Clause 13.1.
records.text: Minute ID: DMPC/MIN/2024/05-02, Date: 2024-05-10, Agenda Item: Post-Defense Thesis Resubmission and Examination Board Procedures. The committee reviewed thesis resubmission guidelines under Clause 13.1. Resolved that the same Examination Board be re-convened for the oral examination of the resubmitted thesis pursuant to Clause 13.1.
